title: Commit the live system code now?

message.text: Can commit-live-system (dispatch #6, brief ai/2026-09-28/commit-live-system/requirements.md) launch now? Code that three tasks build on is uncommitted, and one `git clean` would delete it: ext/Chat/ (Composer.js, Mic, Chat.css), ext/Classify/, plus the edits to ai2/compose.js and public/app.js that use them. Dictate, the page drawer and AI 2 all depend on it, and so do Servex/Pool.js, Server/merge.mjs and Server/window-watch.mjs. The task commits in named groups, by exact path, with no stash or reset and no push, and proves nothing was lost with a hash list taken before and after. Launch line: role `task-mastermind`, name `commit-live-system`, `claude-sonnet-5`, medium, `bypassPermissions`, main tree.
